HotelFaq1.title: Frequently
HotelFaq1.description: Find answers to the most common questions about your stay, facilities, bookings and experiences at Velora Resort & Spa.

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in time is 2:00 PM and check-out time is 12:00 PM. For early check-in or late check-out, please contact our front desk in advance. Requests are subject to availability.

items.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
items.answer: Yes, private airport transfers can be arranged on request. Please share your flight details with our team before arrival so we can coordinate your pickup.

items.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
items.answer: Breakfast inclusion depends on your selected room package. The booking summary clearly shows whether daily breakfast is included with your reservation.

items.question: What dining options are available at the resort?
items.answer: Our resort offers all-day dining, regional specialties, international cuisine, private dining experiences and in-room service for a comfortable stay.

items.question: Do you have a spa and wellness center?
items.answer: Yes, our wellness center offers relaxing spa therapies, rejuvenating treatments, meditation sessions and personalized wellness experiences.

items.question: Are there activities for children?
items.answer: Yes, we offer supervised games, creative activities and family-friendly experiences designed to keep younger guests engaged and entertained.

items.question: Is Wi-Fi available at the resort?
items.answer: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available in guest rooms and throughout the resort's main public areas.

items.question: Can I host a private event or wedding at Velora?
items.answer: Yes, our event team can help plan intimate celebrations, destination weddings and private gatherings with customized spaces, menus and services.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Cancellation terms depend on the room package and dates selected. Please review the policy shown during booking or contact our reservations team for assistance.

items.question: Do you allow pets?
items.answer: Selected accommodation options may welcome pets with prior approval. Please contact us before booking so our team can confirm availability and applicable guidelines.

rooms.title: Ocean View Suite
rooms.description: Experience breathtaking sea views with elegant interiors, premium amenities and a private balcony for a truly relaxing stay.
rooms.imageAlt: Elegant Ocean View Suite at Velora Resort

aboutParagraphs.text: Our Ocean View Suite offers a serene retreat with beautiful coastal views. Spacious interiors, elegant décor and modern facilities create a warm atmosphere for a memorable resort stay.
Enjoy a peaceful morning, relax in the comfortable seating area and unwind in a thoughtfully designed suite where every detail supports complete comfort.

rooms.title: Family Suite
rooms.description: Spacious and comfortable suites designed for families, with flexible sleeping space and easy access to memorable resort activities.
rooms.imageAlt: Family Suite with resort pool access

aboutParagraphs.text: The Family Suite brings everyone together with generous living space, comfortable bedding and thoughtful conveniences for adults and children.
Enjoy easy access to the pool, family dining and resort activities while returning to a calm private space at the end of every day.

rooms.title: Wellness Suite
rooms.description: Rejuvenate your mind and body in a peaceful suite with wellness-inspired comforts, calm interiors and restorative resort experiences.
rooms.imageAlt: Peaceful Wellness Suite at Velora Resort

aboutParagraphs.text: Designed around rest and renewal, the Wellness Suite combines soft natural light, soothing interiors and carefully selected comforts.
Pair your stay with spa treatments, mindful mornings and nourishing dining for a restorative Velora experience.

rooms.title: Honeymoon Suite
rooms.description: Celebrate together in an intimate suite with elegant styling, personalized touches and romantic resort experiences.
rooms.imageAlt: Romantic Honeymoon Suite at Velora Resort

aboutParagraphs.text: The Honeymoon Suite is a private retreat created for meaningful moments, with elegant interiors, romantic details and attentive service.
Enjoy private dining, a couple wellness experience and peaceful evenings designed to make your celebration unforgettable.
